description: This file contains a test script that verifies Git clone and fetch behavior with remote repositories, focusing on handling promisor remotes, filtering, and specific configurations related to lazy fetching and upload-pack scripts.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified directory.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with specified steps.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if a pattern exists in a given output.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies a path does not exist.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verifies a path exists and is a file.

calls: env GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=0 git clone evil lazy-ok
